visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens from a first-person perspective inside a vehicle on a rainy highway. Raindrops heavily blur the windshield and windows. Ahead, a gold sedan and a white SUV are crawling through slow traffic under a gray, overcast sky. (2) As the vehicle moves forward, it passes a large truck that has flipped completely onto its passenger side on the right shoulder. A man in a high-visibility yellow vest stands near the cab, holding a mobile phone. Orange traffic cones mark the area around the wreck. (3) The camera pans to look through the side window, showing the muddy underside and wheels of the overturned truck as it passes. The car then continues forward on the wet asphalt, with other cars visible in the distance through the haze.
